change_reason: A checksum-addressed train/validation audit performed before any confirmatory test access showed that ARC-Challenge contains 3-, 4-, and 5-choice items, while protocol v2 hardcoded a four-class answer head and simultaneously required full splits. V3 repairs that internal incompatibility by freezing a variable-choice scoring interface that preserves all rows and normalizes scores only across the choices actually present for each item. No test data were downloaded or inspected to make this change.
scientific_question: Does LAM-JEPA improve held-out grade-school science multiple-choice accuracy over fair non-JEPA baselines on AI2 ARC-Challenge under a predeclared evaluation protocol?

in_scope: grade-school science multiple-choice reasoning on AI2 ARC-Challenge
calibration on the same multiple-choice task
contribution of the latent-action planner and EMA target mechanism to this ARC result

dataset.name: AI2 ARC-Challenge

split_policy.validation: development, debugging, and model selection only
split_policy.test: single confirmatory evaluation stage after protocol, implementation, and validation-stage choices are frozen

dataset.row_policy: Use every manifest-declared row. Do not filter by answer-choice cardinality. The scorer must support the number of choices present in each item.
dataset.leakage_rule: Any overlapping item ID across train, validation, or test invalidates the run. Test labels or test-derived metrics must not influence model or hyperparameter selection.

training_budget.budget_rule: LAM-JEPA and the matched-capacity supervised baseline use identical rows, epochs, question-level batch size, seeds, optimizer family, and evaluation passes. The pretrained baseline uses the same rows, epochs, question-level batch size, seeds, and evaluation passes; model-specific learning rate is predeclared and compute plus parameter counts must be reported rather than described as parameter matched.

answer_interface.candidate_input: For each question, form one model input per candidate using the same question text and exactly one candidate answer. Do not encode candidate position as a feature.
answer_interface.normalization: Produce one scalar score per candidate and apply softmax only across the candidates present for that question.
answer_interface.batching: A question is the unit of the declared batch size. Implementations may flatten candidate inputs internally but must reconstruct question boundaries exactly before the supervised loss or metrics.
answer_interface.loss: Cross-entropy over each question's available candidate scores plus the predeclared LAM-JEPA auxiliary losses for the full model.
answer_interface.robustness_invariant: Reversing choice order must only reorder candidate scores and remap the label; candidate text scoring itself must not use the original position index.
answer_interface.failure_rule: Any row dropped because it has 3, 4, 5, or another valid positive number of choices invalidates the run. Any confirmatory item with fewer than 2 choices invalidates the dataset row and must be reported rather than silently removed.

lam_jepa.answer_head: shared scalar candidate scorer over the LAM-JEPA representation

majority_reference.type: train-label majority reference conditioned on choice cardinality
majority_reference.rule: Estimate the most frequent zero-based answer index separately for each choice cardinality observed in training; if an unseen cardinality occurs outside training, use deterministic index 0 and record that fallback.

matched_capacity_supervised_baseline.parameter_accounting: Match the exact number of LAM-JEPA parameters that are gradient-active under the protocol-v3 variable-choice ARC training objective. Measure capacity by running the exact full-model variable-choice loss backward pass and summing parameters for which grad is not None. Do not count EMA-only target parameters, auxiliary heads disconnected from the ARC loss, or buffers. Record active and inactive parameter names and counts as evidence.
matched_capacity_supervised_baseline.forward_path_requirement: All counted matched-baseline parameters must be gradient-active under its supervised variable-choice ARC loss on the same accounting check.

strong_pretrained_baseline.parameter_matching: not parameter matched; report exact trainable and total parameters plus training wall time or equivalent compute evidence
strong_pretrained_baseline.variable_choice_rule: Batch or group examples in a way that preserves every question and its actual candidate count; do not pad a candidate with semantic content or drop rows to force four choices.

metrics.uncertainty: paired seed-level 95% bootstrap confidence interval for LAM-JEPA minus each trained baseline
metrics.calibration_primary: multiclass Brier score computed over each item's actual candidate set

robustness.choice_order: deterministically reverse answer choices with exact label remapping and retain per-example paired predictions; the shared candidate scorer must produce correspondingly reordered probabilities for unchanged candidate texts up to numerical tolerance
robustness.failure_rule: A superiority claim is invalid if LAM-JEPA loses more than 0.05 absolute accuracy under the choice-order transform or is more than 0.02 worse than the strongest trained baseline on the same robustness delta.

negative_control.type: deterministic training-label permutation within choice-cardinality strata
negative_control.split: validation only; never use confirmatory test labels for the negative control
negative_control.permutation_rule: Permute training labels deterministically only among questions with the same number of choices so every shuffled label remains a valid candidate index while preserving each cardinality-specific label multiset.
negative_control.failure_rule: If the shuffled-label LAM-JEPA exceeds 0.35 validation accuracy, stop and investigate leakage or shortcut behavior before any test evaluation.

ablations.mechanism_claim_rule: Do not attribute the ARC result to a component unless the paired full-minus-ablation mean accuracy is at least 0.01 and its paired 95% bootstrap confidence interval excludes zero.
ablations.student_state: No student-state contribution claim is made from ARC-Challenge, so this protocol does not use ARC to validate student-state modeling.

claim_gate.superiority: LAM-JEPA may be described as outperforming a baseline only if the mean absolute accuracy gain is at least 0.02 and the paired 95% bootstrap confidence interval for the seed-level accuracy delta excludes zero.
claim_gate.strongest_baseline_rule: Any headline superiority claim must hold against the strongest trained non-JEPA baseline, not only the majority reference or matched scratch baseline.
claim_gate.negative_results: If the gate fails, retain all raw outputs and report the negative or inconclusive result without changing the protocol after seeing test outcomes.

required: raw per-example candidate probabilities and predictions with actual choice counts
proof that every manifest-declared split row was evaluated
training duration or equivalent compute evidence
aggregate statistics derived from raw seed records
artifact_contract.independent_qa: Lane 08 must reproduce the immutable result commit before any RESEARCH_COMPLETE classification.

protocol_change_rule: V1 and V2 remain immutable audit history. V3 supersedes V2 before confirmatory test access after a train/validation-only cardinality audit exposed the fixed-four-choice/full-split incompatibility. Any material change after V3 is merged requires a new protocol version before confirmatory test access. Never silently edit V1, V2, or V3 in response to observed test results.
